runs.question: What does the memo require agencies to do within 180 days? I mean OMB M-25-21, the April 2025 memo.

answer.text:
Within 180 days, M-25-21 requires each agency to submit a compliance plan to OMB and post it publicly.

- **Compliance plan or determination:** Within 180 days of the issuance of the memorandum or any update to it, and every two years thereafter until 2036, each agency must submit to OMB and post publicly on its website either a plan to achieve consistency with the memorandum, or a written determination that the agency does not use and does not anticipate using covered AI.
- **Internal AI principles:** Agencies must also include plans to update any existing internal AI principles and guidelines to ensure consistency with the memorandum.
- **Templates:** OMB will provide templates for these compliance plans.

The summary timeline on page 25 lists "180 days, and every two years until 2036". This matches the compliance-plan cadence. The table text is fragmentary, so I can't confirm from it alone which action each deadline belongs to.

Other deadlines in M-25-21 are separate from the 180-day item. For example, within 270 days agencies must revisit and update where necessary their internal policies on IT infrastructure, data, cybersecurity, and privacy.

M-25-21 rescinds and replaces OMB Memorandum M-24-10. That is why the compliance-plan requirement I described earlier from M-24-10 reads almost identically. M-25-21 now governs.
